name: Makakhiwe Masuku
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: Hello and Welcome, I am Makakhiwe “Mak” (they/them) is a Psychotherapist and Counsellor, Facilitator, and advocator for healing. With several years of experience in the community sector providing trauma-informed and culturally responsive therapeutic care. I specialise in supporting individuals and families through anxiety and depression, trauma, grief and loss, relationship breakdowns and family violence, systems and racial challenges, and shifting family dynamics. Whether you're navigating life experiences, trauma, grief, neurodivergence, I hold space for your story with care, curiosity, and compassion.

name: Mariana Raquel Hahir
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: Mariana Hahir Clinical Counselling Services is dedicated to providing a safe and supportive environment for individuals seeking counselling and psychotherapy. Our goal is to help clients navigate through life's challenges and empower them to achieve personal growth and mental well-being. We offer a range of counselling services, including individual, adult and child counselling and psychotherapy, based on Client-Centred Therapy, Psychodynamic Therapy, Dialectical Behavioural Therapy (DBT) and Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT), Trauma and Grief Therapy from a trauma informed perspective, and Attachment Theory in Clinical Practice to support clients through various life transitions and emotional difficulties.

name: Marilyn Vaccaro
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
description: SHEvolution Space Online Counselling SHEvolution Space offers holistic, online counselling for women and LGBTQIA+ individuals seeking clarity, emotional balance, and meaningful personal growth. This is a calm, confidential space where you are supported to explore what may be holding you back, work through challenges, and move toward a more grounded, aligned version of yourself. Sessions are tailored to you, focusing on uncovering limiting patterns, strengthening self-awareness, and building practical emotional tools to support your wellbeing, relationships, and day-to-day life.

name: Marissa Mallari
title: Counsellor (ACA Proficient)
description: Marissa is a dedicated and compassionate Counsellor with a passion for helping individuals navigate life's challenges. She has honed her skills in providing empathetic and non-judgmental support to those seeking guidance on their journey toward mental and emotional well-being. Marissa completed her undergraduate degree in Psychology in Canada, concluding her studies through the Counselling Masters program at Monash University.
